names.note: Read out of the title on his name link behind the company's line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Евфросин (Антонов), иеромонах, прмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off. The line itself gives the forename in the genitive, «Евфросина», and no surname.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(1937)» after the line of ten people he is the ninth of. Nothing else on the calendar dates him: no life page follows his name, and his name page carries two days and no text.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Всеволода , Александра , Сергия и Алексия и Василия , Петра , Василия пресвитеров, прмч. Анатолия , Евфросина и мч. Иакова (1937).»
source.note: The line is the seventh of the day and names ten people with one year for all of them; «прмч.» governs his name and the one before it, apart from the «Сщмчч.» that governs the seven presbyters. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The line's «прмч.» is venerable-martyr, a monastic put to death, and here the name link agrees with it where it disagreed for the other monastic on the line; the link's «иеромонах» is the grade and goes in `office` as Hieromonk. The surname «Антонов» returns no other folder in the corpus, and the corpus's ten other Euphrosyni and Euphrosynes are other people on other days, the nearest in kind being `euphrosynus-of-sinozero`, a hermit killed in 1612. The ten on this line are not recorded as a company: no page read says they were tried together, and sharing a day of death is not a relation. azbyka.ru answered 403 to this corpus's fetcher on the day he was read.
